reviewer.method: Independent candidate review using the register, shipped definitions, universal terms, relationships, frozen dictionaries, and sampled representations.
reviewer.limitations: Reviewer saw the register and prior label review. This is not blinded review or human review. No classifier predictions were inspected.

recommendationMeaning.proposal-ready: Ready to draft a proposal after resolving listed drafting details. This does not authorize installation.
recommendationMeaning.needs-definition: Resolve semantic boundaries, mapping, or source ambiguity before drafting a proposal.
recommendationMeaning.defer: Existing coverage or inadequate sampled evidence does not presently justify a new proposal.

evidencePolicy: Each candidate has one independent source group. Multiple Synthea tables or NCES columns do not constitute a second source. Non-null counts describe the frozen first-100-row corpus only.
sensitivityPolicy: Suggested sensitivity is a proposed role default for real equivalents. Synthetic data does not lower that default. Public fields do not authorize disclosure of linked records.

sharedBlockerDefinitions.human-review: A human must review the definition, crosswalk, sensitivity, examples, and collision handling before promotion.
sharedBlockerDefinitions.second-source-or-workflow: Provide either an independent second source or a validated product workflow, as required by the register.
sharedBlockerDefinitions.proposal-definition-and-detectors: Author a reviewed definition, representative and negative values, detector scope, role family, domain, and explicit sensitivity overrides.
sharedBlockerDefinitions.regression-gates: Run representative collision and sensitivity regressions plus normal repository smoke, unit, bundle, and final check gates after implementation.
sharedBlockerDefinitions.promotion-packaging: Follow taxonomy/v0.x/proposed/README.md for domain membership, types, crosswalk, relationships, migrations, edition, and proposal lifecycle.

reviews.rationale: Formatted NCES telephone values fall outside phone_e164. The existing universal term fits; institutional publication does not justify a public default.
blockers: Define country context, extensions, short codes, and precedence for E.164 values.

reviews.rationale: iso_date covers the nine sampled dates. The narrower role adds person-linked sensitivity; temporal_instant fits with an explicit sensitivity override.
blockers: Require death-specific headers and preserve date-only semantics.

reviews.rationale: Synthetic license identifiers establish meaning but not jurisdictional format coverage. national_id overlaps government-issued personal identity semantics; passport_number requires separation.
blockers: Decide subtype precedence against national_id and collect jurisdiction-varied license examples.

reviews.rationale: uuid covers the sampled representation. A healthcare claim role distinguishes claims from encounters; the public case_identifier default needs a secret override.
blockers: Limit the generic-looking ID to healthcare claims or rename it; require healthcare context for bare Id.

reviews.rationale: vendor_id already explicitly covers service providers. A person_identifier mapping fits individual clinicians but excludes organizational providers; one referring-provider field is entirely null.
blockers: Define whether this role covers individuals only; justify specialization and obtain non-null referral evidence.

reviews.rationale: The frozen dictionary identifies all three fields as payer keys, including misleading patient-insurance headers. uuid covers their representation; identifier fits organization identity.
blockers: Require dictionary or contextual evidence before treating patient-insurance headers as payer IDs; preserve linked-record sensitivity separately.

reviews.rationale: uuid covers the sample. identifier fits legal organizations; facility_code and vendor_id may overlap when organizations operate sites or supply care.
blockers: Define organization versus physical facility versus provider boundaries and demonstrate a workflow needing this distinction.

reviews.rationale: NCESSCH identifies an institution; facility_code may already cover physical schools. Virtual schools make facility_identifier narrower than the proposed school-entity meaning.
blockers: Choose institution versus campus scope; prefer identifier for institutions and preserve leading zeros.

reviews.rationale: NCES and state agency codes identify administrative organizations. identifier fits; record_id lacks this business meaning and student_id identifies people.
blockers: Retain issuing-authority and jurisdiction context; do not assume NCES and state identifiers share a namespace.

reviews.rationale: School names describe institutions, outside vendor_name and government agency_name definitions. organization_name fits but inherits PII without an explicit public override.
blockers: Define institution-name scope and distinguish campuses or buildings from organizations.

reviews.rationale: The sole sampled value spans 2021-2022. calendar_year excludes this range; temporal is safer than a year mapping that might imply a single year.
blockers: Define academic periods, start/end conventions, shortened forms, and ordering; review temporal versus a dedicated period term.

reviews.rationale: population explicitly covers counts for a group and covers these student aggregates. Many headers from one NCES table do not establish independent source diversity.
blockers: Demonstrate a distinct workflow benefit; specify sentinel handling, overlapping groups, and small-cell disclosure safeguards.

reviews.rationale: Values represent students per teacher, not percentages or probabilities. ratio is appropriate; no shipped role covers this unitless education ratio.
blockers: Define denominator basis, zero-denominator handling, and missing sentinels; forbid summing ratios.

reviews.rationale: Fractional values support an FTE measure. quantity as a runtime type describes inventory or production counts; the universal quantity term is broader.
blockers: Confirm FTE basis from a source definition beyond the Total Teachers alias; distinguish headcount and fractional staffing.

reviews.rationale: BBL identifies land parcels, not necessarily facilities. identifier fits better than facility_identifier; incident-linked parcels require the adjudicated PII treatment.
blockers: Define cadastral namespaces, leading zeros, parcel splits, and contextual sensitivity for public cadastral catalogs.

reviews.rationale: PHONE, ONLINE, and MOBILE classify intake channels. category fits; marketing attribution and payment method types describe different processes.
blockers: Define unknown-channel sentinels and require support-intake context.

reviews.rationale: The dictionary describes care settings. admission_type describes admission circumstances and does not cover wellness or ambulatory settings; category needs a secret override.
blockers: Define encounter-setting vocabulary and resolve overlapping emergency headers against admission_type.

reviews.rationale: The cited CODE field is explicitly an encounter SNOMED code, not documented as a procedure code. diagnosis_code does not cover arbitrary SNOMED concepts.
blockers: Rename or narrow to encounter code, or add actual procedure evidence; require code-system and clinical-context guards.

reviews.rationale: amount covers both fields. Base encounter cost and lifetime patient-paid expenses differ in payer perspective and aggregation grain; monetary_amount fits both.
blockers: Define cost versus charge versus patient payment, currency, time basis, and aggregation grain before combining these fields.

reviews.rationale: claim_amount already includes amounts paid on medical claims and covers PAYER_COVERAGE. amount covers lifetime coverage totals; sum_insured means a policy limit.
blockers: Rename or define paid coverage versus entitlement limits; preserve per-encounter versus lifetime grain.

reviews.rationale: amount covers outstanding balances. Every non-null sampled value is zero, so the sample cannot establish nonzero behavior or balance-sign conventions.
blockers: Obtain nonzero balances; distinguish owed, originally claimed, and paid amounts with a demonstrated workflow.

reviews.rationale: The dictionary maps 1 and 2 to professional and institutional claims. Samples also contain 0; category fits but the extra code remains undefined.
blockers: Resolve code 0 and missing-value semantics; specify institutional versus professional claim scope.

reviews.rationale: city covers the dictionary's town meaning. Compound sampled place strings support a broader birthplace role; location needs an explicit PII override.
blockers: Define town versus compound place representations and require birth-specific context.

reviews.rationale: The evidence specifically covers five-digit county codes. geographic_region fits county geography; generic FIPS is broader than this evidence.
blockers: Narrow to geographic county/state identifiers; preserve zero padding and distinguish jurisdiction levels and non-geographic FIPS uses.

reviews.rationale: amount covers numeric income. compensation covers employment pay; median_income covers group medians. Individual annual income merits explicit scope and financial handling.
blockers: Define person versus household income, annual basis, gross/net treatment, currency, and bracket exclusion.

reviews.rationale: Virtual delivery mode is an institutional status, not a boolean. Sampled Not Reported requires missingness treatment; status fits.
blockers: Specify full, supplemental, nonvirtual, and unknown states without converting all nonzero codes to true.

reviews.rationale: Institutional levels differ from student grade_level and attained education_level. category fits elementary, middle, high, and prekindergarten institutions.
blockers: Define combined and ungraded schools; require institutional headers to avoid student-level collisions.

reviews.rationale: The fields encode start-of-year operations, including future opening. status fits; course completion and application status are different processes.
blockers: Preserve effective academic year and code-label equivalence; obtain additional operating states.

reviews.rationale: Regular, alternative, technical, and special education describe school institutions. category fits; school_level and property_type describe different dimensions.
blockers: Define institution type independently from grade span, delivery mode, and program participation.

reviews.rationale: The cited fields mix Title I eligibility, schoolwide eligibility, and participation descriptions. status fits broadly but a single role may discard these distinctions.
blockers: Separate eligibility from participation and schoolwide scope; define N and numbered text codes before broadening beyond Title I.

reviews.rationale: NCES locale values classify settlement type and remoteness rather than identify a geographic region. category fits better than geographic_region.
blockers: Define settlement-category scope, NCES code hierarchy, and geography-independent classification boundaries.

reviews.rationale: Park and Recreation Center identify venue kinds; INTERSECTION and ADDRESS identify address representations. Combining them conflates two dimensions.
blockers: Split venue kind from address representation or provide an explicit discriminated definition.

reviews.rationale: Named parks denote places rather than legal organizations. organization_name is inappropriate for many facilities; the landmark evidence is entirely null.
blockers: Use title or review a place-name term; bound landmark coverage and handle Unspecified as a sentinel.

reviews.rationale: The frozen dictionary supports facility category semantics but the sampled column is entirely null. category fits; overlap with location_type remains unresolved.
blockers: Collect non-null values and resolve facility-kind versus location-kind scope before drafting detectors.

reviews.rationale: The dictionary includes last actions and future steps, not only final resolutions. label broadly covers text; narratives can contain personal information.
blockers: Define action/update versus final-resolution scope; add diverse narrative examples and sensitivity-aware handling beyond two boilerplate samples.

reviews.rationale: State-plane X/Y values fall outside decimal latitude/longitude semantics. geo_coordinate is plausible with CRS metadata; precise incident locations need a PII override.
blockers: Specify coordinate reference system, units, axis identity, pairing, and missing-CRS behavior; do not infer latitude/longitude from scalar ranges.

reviews.rationale: WKT POINT values combine longitude and latitude; scalar coordinate roles do not cover the representation. geo_coordinate fits with incident-location PII handling.
blockers: Define supported WKT or structured forms, coordinate order, CRS, and rejection of non-point geometries.

reviews.rationale: DPR and DOB are agency acronyms. agency_name may cover acronyms as names; identifier requires a stable namespace or lookup rather than brevity alone.
blockers: Establish code-versus-abbreviated-name policy and jurisdiction-scoped identity; two acronyms do not justify a general detector.

reviews.rationale: The dictionary describes TLC vehicle categories, but the sampled column is entirely null. category fits; a general vehicle type exceeds taxi evidence.
blockers: Collect non-null transport examples and choose taxi-specific versus general vehicle scope; reconsider the customer-support domain.

reviews.rationale: The dictionary describes bridge/highway names but this field is entirely null in the sample. location fits; address_line partially overlaps street-name usage.
blockers: Collect named infrastructure values; define roads versus bridges and assess street-name fields as additional evidence.

reviews.rationale: The dictionary describes direction at an incident, but all sampled values are null. category fits; direction is neither a road identity nor a coordinate.
blockers: Collect cardinal and traffic-direction examples; distinguish heading, bound direction, and carriageway side.

reviews.rationale: The dictionary says additional information about a section, not necessarily a named segment identifier. All sampled values are null; precise incident context warrants PII.
blockers: Obtain values and define named segment versus free-text location detail; reconsider sensitivity for public infrastructure catalogs.
